name: RPM International Inc.
business: RPM makes specialty coatings, sealants, roofing, waterproofing and flooring systems and consumer repair brands for construction, industrial and DIY customers.

events.what: Named President and COO (internal; group presidents now report to him, also leads strategy and corporate development); Sullivan stays Chair and CEO but gives up President title. Reads as succession grooming, not a CEO change.
events.from: RPM EVP since 2025-10-02; before that Group President, Performance Coatings Group; about 25 years at RPM
events.source: 8-K 0001193125-26-311276 (Item 5.02 not parsed by the structured sweep; read from the filing)

events.what: Elected Executive Vice President over finance, legal, HR, manufacturing and operations
Next operating improvement plan (MAP 3.0) and strategy update to be laid out at Investor Day; $75M of SG&A savings in fiscal 2027 called a down payment
Directors added: Julie Beck (Terex CFO) 2025-04-07; Thomas Gentile (ex CEO Hexcel, Spirit AeroSystems) 2026-04-20; nominee Jeffrey Rowe (ex CEO Syngenta, ADM COO) for the 2026-10-08 annual meeting
VP Operations (MAP program lead) retires to Project Management Officer

next_event.source: doc 68799, Sullivan 2026-07-22: 'We are looking forward to providing a strategy update and additional details on our next operating improvement plan at an Investor Day, which will be held on Monday, November 9th of this year.'

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Target is adjusted EBIT margin 16% (first set fall 2018 under MAP to Growth, re-set for MAP 2025 at Investor Day 2022 for fiscal 2025, missed). Gap is measured against VA consensus operating margin (FY2028 14.45%), not EBITDA. VA operating margin ran below company adjusted EBIT (FY2026 VA 12.84% vs adjusted EBIT 13.3% per DEF 14A PSU table), so the true gap may be 30 to 50 bps smaller. Board's own FY2026-FY2028 PSU target is only 14% adjusted EBIT margin by May 31, 2028 (threshold 13%, max 15%), below consensus. ceo_months_in_seat 286 is a lower bound: Sullivan CEO since 2002 (month not stated in DEF 14A doc 159267).

statements.quote: I fully expect over the next two or three years that we're going to get to that 16% margin target. It did not come as quickly as we wanted, but it's still front of mind. It still has some incentive compensation tied to it. It is still a goal that we expect to achieve. We will not get to a 16% EBIT margin in fiscal 2026, but we'll make progress.
statements.speaker: Frank Sullivan
statements.doc_title: RPM INTERNATIONAL INC Q4 2025 Earnings Call

statements.quote: The SG&A-focused actions we implemented last fiscal year are on track to deliver $75 million of savings in the new 2027 fiscal year. As a reminder, we consider this a down payment on our new MAP 3.0 strategic plan.
statements.speaker: Frank Sullivan
statements.doc_title: RPM INTERNATIONAL INC Q4 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: Yes, we do have line of sight to meaningful margin improvement in the coming years. We'll provide more detail on that at our November 9th investor meeting. Yes, it will require a return to unit volume growth in our Consumer business
statements.speaker: Frank Sullivan
statements.doc_title: RPM INTERNATIONAL INC Q4 2026 Earnings Call

statements.quote: As we launch MAP 2025, MAP is now an acronym for Margin Achievement Plan, and the margin we are most focused on achieving is a 16% EBIT margin.
statements.speaker: Tim Kinser

margin_framing.first_stated: 2018 (fall; exact date not stated, per Sullivan doc 55158)

street.gap_assumption: 16% adjusted EBIT target vs VA consensus operating margin for Baba FY2028 (company fiscal 2028, ending May 2028; May year end so labels match company years). Target year 2028 taken as the outer end of Sullivan's 'next two or three years' from 2025-07-24. Consensus operating margin FY2026 12.84%, FY2027 13.32%, FY2028 14.45%. VA has not loaded Q4 FY2026 actuals.
street.source: Baba data_financials consensus (summary and fundamentals), data_comps

evidence_of_progress.note: VA EBITDA margin yoy: Q2 FY2026 -164 bps, Q3 FY2026 +187 bps (Q4 FY2026 not loaded). LTM 15.39% is Q4 FY2025 to Q3 FY2026. Fiscal 2026 adjusted EBIT margin 13.3% vs MAP 2025 16% goal; 2024-2026 PSUs forfeited (0% vested) and fiscal 2026 PERS EBIT margin result 13.0% vs 15.3% target (DEF 14A doc 159267). Raw material inflation guided 5%-6% in Q1 FY2027 and up to 6%-8% in Q2 FY2027.

verdict: Cheap, stabilized, with a CEO-stated 16% EBIT target 155 bps above consensus and an Investor Day on 2026-11-09, but the CEO has run RPM since 2002 and the target has slipped since 2018.
open_questions: Does the 2026-11-09 Investor Day (MAP 3.0) restate 16% adjusted EBIT with a fiscal year, or reset lower toward the board's 14% PSU target for fiscal 2028?
Is Dennsteadt's promotion to President and COO the start of a CEO handover, and on what timeline ('next couple of years' per Sullivan)?
How much of fiscal 2027 margin is lost to 5%-8% raw material inflation before pricing catches up?
